reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 35. Nay or No: 5. Not Voting: 0. Of 40 Yea or Nay votes where the Republican majority could be computed, 40 (100%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 210 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.

Today, we honor the brave men and women who have worn our nation’s uniform and answered the call to serve.

As a proud U.S. Army veteran, I know firsthand the commitment and sacrifice that come with serving our country. To all who have served, thank you. Our nation is forever indebted to you.

Happy Veterans Day.

Today is Election Day!

Polls across Ohio's 15th District are open until 7:30 p.m., so there is still plenty of time to make your voice heard.

Before heading out, take a minute to confirm your polling location and check your sample ballot at https://t.co/cFj7sXNna5.

Thank you to everyone who stopped by. I always enjoy spending time with the next generation of Ohioans. Happy Halloween! https://t.co/BhpbXK3Afo

Great to be back at Hikma Pharmaceuticals’ Columbus manufacturing site to see the progress on its expanded production lines and meet with employees.

Sixteen months after joining Hikma for the groundbreaking of its new wing, it’s exciting to see the project on track to be fully operational next year.

Hikma manufactures affordable, high-quality generic medicines right here in Ohio, while creating good-paying jobs for Ohioans. I’m proud to support their continued investment in our state and their work to lower health care costs for Americans.

It was great to have SBA Administrator Kelly Loeffler in Columbus for a visit to MSI to see firsthand how Ohio manufacturers are helping drive innovation and strengthen our economy.

Manufacturers like MSI play an important role in keeping our country competitive, and I appreciated the opportunity to discuss how we can continue supporting Ohio businesses, strengthening our workforce, and creating more good-paying jobs.

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
